question: What claim is at stake in holding that the practice of the soul has been told to the one addressed?
premises: That something is the practice of the soul.
It has been told to the addressed one, O Bhairavī.
inference: The practice of the soul is now declared to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: No details of the practice are given in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
